claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of this package recovers P in G1 with e(P,Q) = z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q (P = infinity for z = 1) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh algorithm coins (modelled 0.4027): success = (1 - 2^-190) x (1 - P(abort)) with the Wiedemann projections bound N/r < 2^-190 (verified on dropped rows, retried with fresh projections) and Markov P(abort) <= 1.5E'/cap <= 0.60 — one full allowance point inside the floor; every probabilistic premise is a proven bound or a charged cost. The boot is charged at the relation-level aggregate psi_boot = 0.657229 under conditional domination (P(ball k fails | any history) <= psi_boot, the per-instance bin-worst bound), E[#balls] <= 1/(1 - psi_boot) on the collection share only — no independence premise anywhere. E' = 2^120.271466 is the descent expectation with every yield component degraded x0.75 beyond its one-sided charge plus that restart (a further x2 on the failure shapes is priced live in the output, +3.398 bits, disclosed uncharged). A global meter bounds all classical work — preprocessing, failures, restarts, transfers, storage, verification and output — by W <= 2^122.95 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instructions; the ledger totals 2^122.946314, reproduced exactly by the deterministic in-sandbox recompute: relation collection 2^121.9501 (B = 2^69, the descent plan's native factor base; per-cell 461.28 at C_NB_EVAL = 4,000 from a measured 3,974.3 Ir/evaluation, bit-identical survivor sets on all 2,401 pool rows), linear algebra 2^119.7003, descent cap 2^121.60 (the smallest 0.01-grid value above the exact threshold log2(1.5E'/0.60) = 121.5934), small terms 2^90.3231. The full construction, the tower certificates ([0e] the (41, y-33) reduction with the integrality argument; [0f] the (31, y-28, z-29) non-square residue witness with the index-coprime lift, N(D) = 8 mod 31; [0g] Capelli with the algebraic discriminant transfer and the sigma fixed-field bookkeeping), the per-cell price, the descent model with the adaptive-tree bound, and the block-segmented storage layout (peak total <= 2^105 bytes, no object above 2^61 bytes) are in the in-archive PROOF.md; the experiment output recomputes and prints every check (22 named checks). Under the disclosed NFS heuristics (H3's discriminant half verified exactly; the class-number half the standard disclosed hypothesis). Nothing is amortised over future targets.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes in-sandbox everything specified in the in-archive PROOF.md, with 22 named checks ([0]-[8]: the tower certificates including the f-field bridge — the (41, y-33) reduction, the (31, y-28, z-29) non-square witness, the Capelli assembly — the discriminant identities, the pool, the measurement parse with the compressed-kernel sha256, the relation-collection ledger at the calibrated s*, the linear-algebra charge, the retention laws and E-ladder with the mu-degraded model and its self-check, the cap grid with the relation-level boot restart and the conditional-domination chain, the total, and the storage arithmetic). The output is self-contained and its quoted_offline list states the evidence split.
